name: shopify-app-builder
description: Beginner-friendly Shopify app engineering skills for researching, building, testing, launching and maintaining merchant-safe apps.

interface.longDescription: An open-source Shopify app-building partner with 36 focused skills, 17 guided command definitions and 8 specialist-agent definitions. A local project copilot adds portable context, cross-session handoffs, stale-assumption reminders, optional redacted feedback and Markdown/visual HTML progress reports. Check-in plans stay proposed until a supported host scheduler is explicitly configured. Covers official Shopify CLI/Dev Dashboard setup, optional Apify CLI competitor research, architecture, APIs, auth, billing, webhooks, extensions, merchant UX, tests, privacy and release readiness. No bundled MCP server, telemetry, required cloud account, automatic store access or paid research. Execution and scheduling depend on the user's harness and separately authorized tools; native command/agent support varies. Reports describe recorded evidence, not certification or guaranteed app approval.
defaultPrompt: Find guidance for Shopify app OAuth and webhook verification.
Open the Shopify app billing guidance and summarize key checks.
Plan a Shopify app that syncs inventory and handles product webhooks.

publication.release_notes: Version 2.1.1 local candidate improves focused build/fix/audit/improve/import/review/release/resume routing, first merchant-feature acceptance and recovery. The contained offline helper adds read-only metadata inspection, portable handoffs and safe JSON receipts with partial-result recovery. Retains 36 skills, 17 commands, 8 specialist definitions and schema-1 state. Claude uses its documented default agent scan. Includes regression coverage and eight prepared native evaluation cases, not measured behavioral uplift. No MCP, telemetry, automatic scheduling or paid calls. Publication and host execution remain separate checks.
